seeds.name: Arithmetic accumulation loop plus iterative-Fibonacci calls
seeds.description: A 1,500,000-iteration modulo-accumulation loop plus 30 calls into an iterative Fibonacci helper, interpreted as Go source; about 110-115 ms.

seeds.name: strings.Builder concatenation and fmt.Fprintf formatting
seeds.description: Builds a 90,000-byte string via strings.Builder, then formats 20,000 lines with fmt.Fprintf into a second builder; about 70-75 ms.

seeds.name: Map churn followed by sort.Strings/sort.Ints
seeds.description: Populates and increments a 60-key map across 220,000 insertions, sorts its keys with sort.Strings (Go map iteration order is not guaranteed, so the workload sorts before summing), then sorts a 12,000-element numeric list with sort.Ints; about 75-80 ms.

seeds.name: Same arithmetic/recursion workload at much higher volume
seeds.description: A 70,000,000-iteration version of fib-arithmetic's accumulation loop for the macOS sampler; about 4.6-4.8 s.
